title: A shard takes a person only through the master's signed adopt and a one-time ticket, mails no sign-in code, and holds a label at the master before creating a site
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd` with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch Postgres. The master is a local double; no server is reached.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
No site row and no provision after a create refused for an unreachable master.
No session cookie on any refused handoff.
fence: An unsigned, mis-signed or replayed adopt is 403 with a reason and writes no mirror; a ticket opens a session once and only with the nonce whose hash adopt stored; two nonce cookies, another browser, a used or late ticket send the person back to the master with no session; a shard never mails a sign-in code; a shard session cookie alone passes no cross-site POST; a create is refused with no site row when the master cannot hold the label. Throwaway Postgres and local doubles, no network.

tests: an unsigned, mis-signed or replayed adopt is refused with why, and creates nothing
adopt makes the mirror once and answers a one-time ticket as a string, with the master’s nonce hash kept
next is kept with the ticket, as a path of this shard, never /handoff itself
a body off the contract is 400 BAD_BODY, and the master gets 404 NOT_A_SHARD
a shard that has not read the catalogue, or is full, answers SHARD_FULL to a NEW person and still takes back a known one
a signed request verifies once; replay, clock and every other change say why
a nonce is remembered to the end of ITS OWN window: a signer whose clock runs ahead cannot replay it
a ticket and its nonce become a session of this shard, once, with W1’s cookies and no pointer
only t is read: a next in the query never chooses where the person lands
a ticket without its nonce, with another browser’s, a used one or a late one goes back to the master and sets no session
two tracy_handoff cookies are a broken ticket, spent and signed in nowhere; a failed handoff never goes back to /handoff
a shard sends sign-in to the master and never mails a code
a browser posting the old form gets a page in its language with a way to the master
the master signs people in exactly as before
a same-site POST carrying only tracy_sess_<name> is 403 CSRF_ORIGIN: the guard reads the shard cookie too (contract §3)
forwardHttp on a shard hands dsh the shard’s own session, not the master’s cookie beside it
a person the master never handed here cannot create a site on the shard
a handed person creates a site: the label is held at the master first and site.created is queued before the provision
the master holding the label elsewhere is the same TAKEN refusal as a local clash, and nothing is written
the master not answering refuses the create with LABEL_REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE and leaves no site behind
a shard that has not read the catalogue, or is at its cap, answers SHARD_FULL with the master’s fresh start
the heartbeat reads sites, catalogue read time, migration head and accepting, signed as a GET
the heartbeat’s shell signature (W3) is the same as signShardRequest for GET /_shard/status
